memory_update.text: POWL should remain a high-priority underfollowed/direct node candidate because it has explicit data-center mega-order and backlog evidence in medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems.

IESC is an execution/integration candidate rather than a pure equipment manufacturer; survival into later layers requires proof that custom engineered solutions are tied to switchgear, power modules, substations, or interconnection work.

PLPC is a second-order grid/substation hardware candidate with low AI mindshare; later layers should test whether utility capex in data-center-heavy regions is converting into identifiable order growth.
Eaton should be used as the reference demand validator for Electrical Americas backlog and data-center order acceleration, not as the main underfollowed alpha candidate.

Need a separate materials/components pass for grain-oriented electrical steel, copper busbar, insulation, transformer oil, relays/protection, testing/inspection, and transformer repair/refurbishment companies.

node: Power transformers, switchgear, substations, and grid-interconnection equipment
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the transformer/switchgear/substation node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Reference lane: Eaton as the obvious large electrical-equipment validator. Underfollowed lane: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged power systems, IES Holdings for electrical/data-center infrastructure execution and custom engineered solutions, and Preformed Line Products for grid/substation hardware that can benefit one step away from the obvious AI data-center buildout. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
